records.lesson: Never turn security evidence into a permanent person score; assess the exact proposed action and consequence.
Suspicion should narrow authority proportionately; unrelated low-risk service may remain available.
A third-party allegation may be relevant evidence but remains explicitly unverified unless independently established.
Institutional evidence storage, not conversational memory, carries relevant concerns into later sessions.
An LLM may help author policy; operative policy is a fixed reviewable versioned artifact.
Assessment traces should retain causal finding/evidence identities so a decision can be reconstructed.
Counterevidence and unknowns must remain first-class or the system degenerates into a false-positive generator.
Injection-looking or enumeration behavior is evidence/finding, not automatic declaration that a person is an attacker.
Opening a review case must not fabricate DECISION or ACCOUNT_CONTROL authority.
Security ALLOW is semantic evidence; Access Permissions separately decides exact method/object authority.
Permission ALLOW cannot erase Security HOLD/REVIEW_REQUIRED.
Method authority is exact-object scoped and must not float to another instance of the same class.
Exact method/object binding is insufficient if live arguments or context can change; bind argument/context identity.
A successful exact Security+Permission execution consumes its single-use invocation evidence to prevent replay.
Long/staged operations need fresh Security revalidation immediately before irreversible commit.
Security admission does not prove work actually started; continuation requires separate host execution-evidence identity.
Commit revalidation must bind exact staged-state and live context identities.
New adverse evidence discovered after admission can legitimately change commit from ALLOW to HOLD.
Canary metrics/topology are institutional deployment evidence and never become customer Security findings.
Rollback selects the exact prior reviewed policy artifact; it does not synthesize a replacement.
Promotion/rollback evidence freshness is anchored to observation time, not re-evaluation time.
A race while consuming commit/invocation evidence must fail closed and never restore replayability.
v0.14 is qualified under ooRexx r13196 against current Crypto v0.8.3, Access Permissions v0.2 and Institutional Policy v0.8.
